einzeiler: Behind the scenes of the 2026 midterms and how Democrats are planning to hold Trump…
kurzfassung: Strategists dissect the recent midterm victories and candidate recruitment successes. Senator Chris Van Hollen discusses holding the Trump administration accountable and fighting for the Senate majority. The panel analyzes the role of big money, super PACs, and evolving digital campaign strategies.
stichpunkte: Campaign strategists review the 2026 midterm wins and what drove voter turnout.
Discussion centers on recruiting non-traditional, authentic candidates rather than relying solely on fundraising ability.
Concerns are raised about digital ad spending and the need to meet voters where they are online.
The impact of outside super PAC spending, particularly AIPAC, in Democratic primaries is heavily criticized.
Senator Chris Van Hollen outlines priorities for the Senate, including ending conflicts and challenging political corruption.
The guests debate the future of the Democratic big tent and moving beyond outdated political labels.
beschreibung:
Live from Crooked Con, Lovett talks with top Democratic strategists Morris Katz, Lis Smith, and Danielle Butterfield about what ads and messages worked in the field, their favorite content from other campaigns, and what pissed them off the most. Then, Alex Wagner sits down with Senator Chris Van Hollen to talk about the Senate leadership fight, holding Trump accountable, and whether he has his eye on 2028.
